card.name: Start of dosing-frequency terms
card.fires_on: The first piece of a dosing-frequency phrase right after a dose or route, such as 'once' daily, or the 'q' or 'b' in q.d., qhs and b.i.d.

modes.label: once daily
modes.description: The word 'once' after a dose or route, before 'daily' or 'a day'.
modes.example: administer antibiotic lotion to the scalp (clindamycin 1% topical<< once>> daily) for the next 9 months

modes.label: Abbreviated frequency
modes.description: The opening letter of Latin-style frequency abbreviations after a mg dose.

card.plain: It fires on the first letter or word of how often a drug is taken, like once daily or b.i.d., right after the dose.
